title: Page Wipe
description: Một tấm màu quét kín khung từ trái sang, đổi trang khi đã che kín, rồi tấm màu rút tiếp sang phải để lộ trang mới.

moworks.author: moworks

options.duration: s (0.78): covers left to right, the scenes swap while covered, then it leaves to the right

moworks.notes: One accent panel over both scenes, 780 ms total, ease easeInOutQuint (CSS cubic-bezier(.83,0,.17,1), about power4.inOut). Leading edge sweeps left to right over 0-374 ms (panel scaleX 0 → 1, origin left); the scenes swap at 390 ms while fully covered; the trailing edge follows over 406-780 ms (scaleX 1 → 0, origin right) so the panel exits right. Params: duration (0.78 s) · color · swap (0.39 s) · ease (power4.inOut) · direction.
